description: Create a security monitoring suppression rule to suppress signals matching a query

dataExclusionQuery.description: Data exclusion query — input events matching this are excluded from detection

enabled.description: Whether the suppression rule is enabled (default true)

expirationDate.description: ISO 8601 expiration date — after this date, suppression stops

ruleQuery.description: Rule query — detection rules matching this query will have signals suppressed. Same syntax as search bar

suppressionQuery.description: Suppression query — signals matching this query are suppressed

name: create-security-suppression
